minecraft:dirt: Dirt, the fundamental base of Minecraft. Used for farming and construction. Can be tilled into farmland with a hoe.
minecraft:stone: Stone, a robust building material. Can be smelted to obtain smooth stone or transformed into various decorative stone types.
minecraft:grass_block: The grass block, symbol of nature in Minecraft. Allows grass growth and can be transformed into dirt with a shovel.
minecraft:cobblestone: Cobblestone, obtained by mining stone. A versatile and durable building material.
minecraft:wooden_planks: Wooden planks, basic building material. Obtained by crafting wood logs.
minecraft:iron_ingot: Iron ingot, precious metal obtained by smelting iron ore. Essential for creating medium-quality tools and armor.
minecraft:gold_ingot: Gold ingot, shiny and precious metal. Used to create fast but fragile tools, as well as decorative items.
minecraft:diamond: Diamond, the most precious gem in Minecraft. Required to create the best tools, armor and weapons in the game.
minecraft:coal: Coal, essential energy source. Used as fuel for furnaces and to create torches.
minecraft:torch: Torch, portable light source. Essential for lighting dark areas and preventing hostile mob spawns.
